| Memphis Grizzlies | 4th place (55‑27) | **0** |
| Utah Jazz | 5th place (54‑28) | **0** |

> **Note:** The Grizzlies and Jazz have never won an NBA title.

So, for the 2023‑24 season itself, the championship tally among the top five Western Conference teams is **1 (the Warriors)**. If you were after the historical count, the figures above apply.
